content: The autonomous-task-brain skill implements a fixed 5-step closed-loop autonomous task management workflow: perceive (scan recent sessions to identify new/recurring/failing tasks) → retrieve (search local skills, historical sessions, memory-engine, letta, and GitHub for optimal solutions) → decide (select execute/suggest/skip based on historical success rate, task complexity, and user preferences) → execute (auto-create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts or delegate subtasks) → review (record execution results and update the knowledge base to optimize future performance), with the core design goal of minimizing user manual intervention for task planning.
